items.title: Adobe and NVIDIA Expand Collaboration to Further Optimize Agentic Creation With Its Flagship Tools
items.excerpt: Adobe and NVIDIA continue to double down on AI with new optimizations for agentic creation in Adobe's flagship tools, including Photoshop, Premiere, Substance 3D, and more.

items.title: Alex Gibney on How a CGI Avatar Helped Simulate the Elon Musk Interview He Could Never Get
items.excerpt: Alex Gibney explains using artificial intelligence to critique it in his documentary 'Musk', building a CGI avatar to simulate the Elon Musk interview he could never get.

items.title: CorridorKey 2.0 just works...
items.excerpt: Corridor Crew shows off CorridorKey 2.0, the new version of the in-house keying tool behind their AI VFX workflow, which composites actors into scenes without a traditional green-screen pull. The video description is only 'This Weekend.', so the enrichment pass needs to confirm what is new in 2.0.

items.title: Mark Wahlberg on using AI in film 'the right way' and being open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy
items.excerpt: Actor and investor Mark Wahlberg says he's OK with AI in filmmaking if it's used 'to enhance what you're doing', and says he is open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy.

items.title: Comics Accuse Hot AI Fakes of Stealing Their Jokes Word for Word to Push OnlyFans Pages
items.excerpt: Stand-up comics are calling out accounts where AI-generated 'comics' plagiarize their jokes word for word, sometimes for millions of views, to push OnlyFans pages: 'AI stole my joke and my outfit.' Deadline also covered it, at https://deadline.com/2026/10/comedians-ai-joke-theft-natalie-cuomo-olivia-carter-1237165762/.

items.title: 'Avatar: Fire and Ash' Composer and More Speak Out About AI at Ghent's WSA Film Music Days: 'We Must Continue to Defend Our Art'
items.excerpt: At the World Soundtrack Awards, 'Avatar: Fire and Ash' composer Simon Franglen said the work of film composers and musicians can never be replicated by AI.

items.title: Hollywood Animation Directors On Distribution, Sequels, And AI
items.excerpt: At View Conference, the directors of 'GOAT', 'Forgotten Island' and 'Toy Story 5' discussed the box office, original storytelling and, unavoidably, AI in animation production.

items.title: BBC's Kate Phillips On AI, YouTube & 'Blue Planet III': We Will Never 'Lie To The Audience'
items.excerpt: At MIPCOM, BBC content chief Kate Phillips said the BBC will never 'lie to the audience' about AI. She spoke after DG Matt Brittin said he had been sent an AI-generated 'Doctor Who' episode and that it was 'pretty good'.

items.title: Tilly Nollywood? African Filmmakers — Ready or Not — Get Set for the AI Revolution
items.excerpt: Generative AI could transform filmmaking in Africa, but practical challenges across the continent abound.

items.title: Tsui Hark Pays Emotional Tribute to Nansun Shi, Discusses New Projects and Reflects on AI at Lumière Festival (EXCLUSIVE)
items.excerpt: At Lumière, Tsui Hark discussed new projects, including a London comedy and a dreamlike future city, and the growing challenges for filmmakers in the age of AI.
